messages:
Mira Chen: quick design review thread 11 API Keys. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Main asks: make disable vs revoke explicit, confirm rotate shows secret once, and fix keyboard/a11y. Can we quick nit copy and behaviour before handoff?

Olivia Park: agree. Two UX rules: 1) primary action on list should be 'Disable key' (safe). 2) Revoke must be two-step: intent -> danger confirmation. Avoid 'Yes/No' labels.

Sam Ortiz: backend: we support both. `disable` toggles a flag; `revoke` deletes the secret and writes audit. Rotation returns secret only once. I'll add idempotency headers to revoke/rotate endpoints.

Lee Nguyen: proto note: focus trap in current modal breaks if animation cancels. I'll ensure: role=alertdialog, aria-describedby, focus primary on open, return focus to kebab on close, ESC to cancel.

Jamal Price: security: plaintext secret must not be stored. For rotate, show secret in ephemeral panel, require explicit copy/download. Download links should be `rel=noopener` and have descriptive aria-labels. Warn on wildcard scopes.

a11y-bot: scan: two failures in comps: 1) danger red contrast below AA on gray bg, 2) ambiguous button labels. Recommend `Revoke key` / `Disable key` / `Cancel` and fix color tokens.

Mira Chen: proposed revoke confirm copy (final modal):
Heading: Revoke API key?
Body: Revoking this key prevents any new requests from using it. Existing requests may complete briefly. This action cannot be undone.
Primary: Revoke key
Secondary: Cancel
Checkbox: Create replacement key after revoke (recommended)
Is the language clear enough?

Olivia Park: copy looks good. Use "prevents any new requests from using it" (explicit). Only show irreversible sentence on the final confirmation modal.

Lee Nguyen: accessibility detail: in key list show truncated `sk-****-3f2a` and add `aria-label=\"API key ending 3f2a\"` so screen readers have context. Also ensure toasts announce results with `aria-live=polite`.

Sam Ortiz: I'll include audit payload: { key_id, user_id, action, reason } and org alert for admin-scoped keys on revoke. ETA swagger PR tomorrow AM.

Mira Chen: rotate success panel microcopy: "This secret will not be shown again. Copy or download now." Primary: Copy & Close. Secondary: Download .txt (aria-label=\"Download new API key\").

Jamal Price: add a small lock icon + caption when key has wildcard scopes: "This key has broad access 1 consider narrowing scopes."

Olivia Park: action items:
- Lee: modal a11y + focus fixes (PR today)
- Sam: endpoints + idempotency + audit (tomorrow)
- Olivia: update Figma to split revoke flow and fix color tokens (tomorrow morning)
- Mira: consolidate final acceptance criteria and copy in this thread
- a11y-bot: re-run checks after PRs

Mira Chen: thanks all 680 I'll post final copy here after changes.
